evidence.title: Mammut Studios — One Page Website Award

name: Mammut Studios
summary: One-page website by Rotterdam digital design studio Mammut Studios, showcased on One Page Love.
description: One Page Love entry for Mammut Studios, a digital design studio in Rotterdam that creates brand identities, designs and Webflow websites. The Dutch-language one-pager uses smooth scrolling and Astro, GSAP, Next.js and Tailwind CSS, with header navigation, highlights, client logo row, services list, testimonial slider, FAQ accordion and footer sections.
